title: cephaelis chiapensis
intro: Cephaelis chiapensis, commonly known as Chiapas Ipecac, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis chiapensis include acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
